summary: The prepared base already included upstream PR 9391's combined prompt-plus-completion auto-truncation. This change preserves that behavior and fixes its reserved-token edge case: prompt truncation now subtracts speculative decoding's reserved output slots and retains those slots in total-token accounting. Added compatibility, regression, and adversarial unit coverage, plus a real source-checkout HTTP/GPU probe of the original OpenAI completion scenario.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before regression on the recorded base with the proposed tests present: the reserved-token prompt case retained 10 tokens when only 7 fit. Three existing-contract cases passed. Raw output: evidence/regression-before.txt.

11 tests and 11 subtests passed, covering enabled auto-truncation, disabled compatibility/error behavior, exact reserved-token prompt and completion budgets, and adjacent tokenizer-manager validation. Raw output: evidence/unit-after.txt.

A real source-checkout server on the assigned MI355X accepted an OpenAI completion requesting 9 prompt + 30 completion tokens with context 32, returned HTTP 200, truncated completion usage to 21 tokens, and reported 30 total tokens. Server logs record the truncation warning, Triton compilation, GPU prefill/decode, request, response, and cleanup.

gpu_execution.evidence: reports/j-5f9146f066fb/evidence/http-gpu-final/server.log and completion.json show execution on the assigned AMD Instinct MI355X/gfx950 through the SGLang Triton backend; run-metadata.json records all assertions true and owned descendants reaped.

remaining_limitations: The qualified fixture has deterministic random Llama weights and validates transport and engine execution only; it does not establish semantic model quality.

The reserved-token regression is validated directly at TokenizerManager with nonzero reserved slots. No speculative draft model was available in the qualified fixture, so that edge case was not exercised end-to-end with EAGLE speculative decoding.
No native C++ or FlyDSL source changed, so a native rebuild was not applicable.

Independent numerical GPU reference comparison was not applicable to this request-validation/control-flow change; the GPU evidence checks protocol status and independently reported token counts against the configured context budget.
